messages:
maya: Starting Valencia customer's LoRA merge (valencia-lora@0.4) into staging for compatibility + quant checks. Focus: tokenizer locale mapping (comma vs dot decimals), small-value currency cases, int4-calib vs int8. Tagging @colin for quant ops and @tara for locale/tokenizer checks.

colin: Got the eval pack now. gs://redwood-evals/valencia/mini-locales-2026-03-24.tar.gz (75 convs, 30 locale currency cases, 15 long receipts). Will run token-map diff first.

tara: FYI Valencia sends amounts using European formatting (1.234,56 EUR) and sometimes uses currency suffixes like ".EUR" vs " EUR". Tokenizer remap needed for DOT_THOUSANDS -> THOUSANDS_COMMA and suffix normalizers.

maya: Running token diff: python tools/token_map_check.py --base open-7b --adapter valencia-lora --out /tmp/valencia-tokenmap.json

eval-bot: token-check complete: remapped=11, oov=4 (".EUR","EUR,","THOUSANDS_DOT","INV#"), artifact: gs://redwood-evals/valencia/tokenmap.json

colin: Patch suggestion: remap ".EUR"->" EUR" and normalize thousands/comma tokens. Also run baseline (adapter without locale soft-prefix) to isolate adapter effects.

maya: Baseline queued. metadata=model=valencia-lora@0.4, base=open-7b@2026-03-16, seed=917

eval-bot: baseline done: money-f1=0.96, numeric-mape=1.1%, p50lat +9ms. Scheduling int4-calibrated (perchannel-asymm, calib=2048) and int8.

colin: Quick note: European comma decimals can be parsed incorrectly by quantized models if token IDs split decimal/grouping differently. Watch for 1.234,56 -> 1234.56 vs 1.23456 errors.

eval-bot: int4-calib run complete: money-f1=0.86, numeric-mape=3.8% 3/30 locale cases failed (mix of decimal/magnitude errors). int8 run: money-f1=0.95, numeric-mape=1.2%. report: http://ci.internal/reports/valencia/job_120301/report.html

tara: Paste top failing examples so we can decide if tokenizer remap or quant is root cause.

maya: Top diffs:
Example X - prompt: "Total: 1.234,56 EUR"
  baseline: "EUR 1.234,56"
  valencia-int4: "EUR 1234.56" (dot inserted, good numeric but formatting shifted)
Example Y - prompt: "Items: 2 x 0,10 EUR"
  baseline: "EUR 0,20"
  valencia-int4: "EUR 0.02" (magnitude drop)
Example Z - long context: cumulative with commas as thousand separators, int4 missed last line and returned lower sum

colin: Example Y suggests quant magnitude collapse on comma-decimal tokens. Try int4 with larger calibration (calib=8192) and token remap pre-normalization step (normalize commas->dots before tokenization for quant runs). Also try disabling soft-prefix for a run.

tara: I prefer normalizing at ingest for locale tokens; but we still need to keep original formatting in outputs. Suggest two-step: eval on normalized tokens for numeric safety, and a post-formatting step to re-render with comma decimals for display.

maya: Relaunching int4-highcalib (calib=8192, perchannel-asymm) with token pre-normalize hook enabled on the eval runner. job=job_120305. seed pinned=20260324.

eval-bot: rerun complete: int4-highcalib money-f1=0.94, numeric-mape=1.4%. Locale failures reduced; long-thread accumulation improved. Artifacts archived: gs://redwood-artifacts/valencia/job_120305.tar.gz

colin: Nice. Recommendation: ship int8 artifact for strict locale-sensitive customers and an int4-highcalib artifact paired with a token pre-normalize + post-format pipeline for lower-cost customers. Add canary routing: valencia-locale-safe -> int8 if money-f1 < 0.93 on recent evals.

tara: Opening ENG-ML-5099 for adapter author to document locale suffixes and to add optional pre-normalize hook in adapter config. Include failing prompts and remap diff.

maya: Created canary route and ticket. Closing loop after 24h bake. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
